No first-round evidence was supplied; all contacts are hypotheses.","expected_discrimination":"Flexible bridging may accommodate E46–K80 distances of 6.8–11.1 Å across MSA, versus 33.7 Å in 8A9L; E46/V48 are largely buried in 6CU7."},{"sequence":"RYSNGSGNDVTRN","hypothesis":"13 aa; polar flexible bridge with Y near V48, D near K80 and R near E83; avoids dependence on variably exposed A78.","expected_discrimination":"Targets the MSA proximity of residues 46/48 to 80–83. These regions are separated in 8A9L, while 6CU7 occludes E46/V48/Q79."},{"sequence":"KFSQGSGSQDVSRQ","hypothesis":"14 aa; K/F anchoring at E46/V48, a compliant glycine/serine spacer and a polar D/V/R terminal anchor at K80/V82/E83.","expected_discrimination":"MSA E46–V82 spans 11.1–17.5 Å, versus 39.1 Å in 8A9L; buried V48 and weak K80 exposure should impede the same pose in 6CU7."},{"sequence":"RWSNGSGSGQDVTRNS","hypothesis":"16 aa; a single W strengthens the V48-facing anchor, while a longer soluble linker tests accommodation of all three MSA geometries.","expected_discrimination":"The linker tests the MSA E46–E83 range of 14.7–20.6 Å without deliberately spanning the 42.8 Å gap in 8A9L; 6CU7 hides the proximal anchor."},{"sequence":"KYSQGSGNGSGQDVTRNQS","hypothesis":"19 aa; highly polar, adaptable bridge between E46/V48 and K80/V82/E83, with limited hydrophobic content.","expected_discrimination":"May tolerate the compact 6XYO and more extended 6XYP/6XYQ patches; 8A9L separates E46 from K80 by 33.7 Å, and 6CU7 buries E46/V48. Linker entropy could reduce selectivity."},{"sequence":"RFSPGQDVTRSN","hypothesis":"12 aa; a PG hinge tests a compact bent pose joining an E46/V48 anchor to K80/V82/E83.","expected_discrimination":"Designed for the 6.8–11.1 Å MSA E46–K80 separation rather than 8A9L's 33.7 Å; 6CU7 has similar geometry but inaccessible E46/V48."},{"sequence":"KYSPNGQDVSRNQ","hypothesis":"13 aa; a proline/asparagine turn biases the bridge while retaining local adaptability and polar Q79/T81 contacts.","expected_discrimination":"Joint engagement of E46 and Q79/K80 is plausible at MSA distances but not the 32.4–33.7 Å separations in 8A9L; Q79 and V48 are buried in 6CU7."},{"sequence":"RFSNPGSQDVTRNS","hypothesis":"14 aa; NPG turn and flanking serines test shape recognition without requiring a rigid helix or an exposed A78.","expected_discrimination":"MSA E46–Q79 distances are 8.4–9.4 Å, versus 32.4 Å in 8A9L; 6CU7 supplies similar distances but little E46/Q79 accessibility."},{"sequence":"KYSAPGNSQDVSRNQS","hypothesis":"16 aa; an APG-biased turn tests a moderately preorganized bridge; D/R provide complementary contacts to K80/E83.","expected_discrimination":"Requires nearby E46/V48 and 79–83 surfaces, present in MSA but spatially separated in 8A9L; 6CU7 buries V48/Q79/T81. Turn rigidity may exclude an MSA conformer."},{"sequence":"RFQSPGNSGQDVTRSNQS","hypothesis":"18 aa; combines a turn with a short flexible extension to balance preorganization against the MSA inter-region distance variation.","expected_discrimination":"Tests E46–V82 separations of 11.1–17.5 Å in MSA versus 39.1 Å in 8A9L; 6CU7 lacks an exposed E46/V48 anchor despite matching much of the geometry."},{"sequence":"RNQSGNQDVTRQ","hypothesis":"12 aa; low-hydrophobicity alternative emphasizing E46, Q79, K80, T81 and E83 through charged and hydrogen-bonding residues.","expected_discrimination":"Requires cooperative E46-to-79–83 engagement, disrupted by 8A9L's long distances and 6CU7's buried E46/Q79/T81. Polar-only anchoring may be weak."},{"sequence":"KQNSGSGQDITRNQS","hypothesis":"15 aa; polar bridge with one I testing V82 packing, D for K80 and R for E83; K supplies an E46-facing anchor.","expected_discrimination":"MSA combines accessible E46/K80/V82/E83 with short inter-region distances; 8A9L is more exposed but geometrically separated, while 6CU7 restricts E46/K80 access."},{"sequence":"RQNSGNGSQEVSRNQTS","hypothesis":"17 aa; replaces the K80-facing D with E to test side-chain reach, with S/N/Q supporting Q79/T81 contacts.","expected_discrimination":"E46–K80 remains 6.8–11.1 Å across MSA but expands to 33.7 Å in 8A9L; 6CU7's E46 and neighboring polar anchors are largely occluded."},{"sequence":"KFNQSGSGNQDTIRSNQTS","hypothesis":"18 aa; distributes polar contacts around Q79/T81 and uses F/I as sparse V48/V82 anchors, testing a different local charge register.","expected_discrimination":"The two hydrophobic anchors target MSA V48–V82 distances of 14.8–21.5 Å, versus 43.8 Å in 8A9L; V48 is fully buried in 6CU7."},{"sequence":"RYNQSGNGSGSNQDVTRNQSTS","hypothesis":"21 aa; extended soluble alternative with Y/R proximal anchoring and a flexible polar bridge to K80/V82/E83. Tests whether adaptability outweighs binding entropy.","expected_discrimination":"Intended to span the MSA E46–E83 range of 14.7–20.6 Å, not 8A9L's 42.8 Å; 6CU7 occludes E46/V48. Assembly-dependent SASA and linker flexibility make discrimination provisional."}]}
